executive_summary:
Lakeside Café is an owner-operated café near a university campus in Kingston, ON. In FY2025 it generated $568,700 in revenue at a 65.7% gross margin, and $109,400 in seller's discretionary earnings (SDE). Weighted SDE across three years is $107,200.

The owner is retiring. The café is open seven days a week with six part-time staff, has four years left on its lease plus a five-year renewal option, and replaced its espresso machine in 2024. At $395,000 the asking price is 3.7x weighted SDE, above the indicative range of $214,400 to $321,600, so the listing will need a clear case for the premium.
investment_highlights: Revenue up from $502,400 in FY2023 to $568,700 in FY2025
Gross margin steady at 65-66% for three years
Four years left on the lease, plus a five-year renewal option
Espresso machine replaced in 2024, so no major equipment spend expected soon
Catering to two local offices adds a second revenue stream, about 15% of sales
business_overview: Lakeside Café is a single-location coffee shop near a university campus in Kingston. Alongside walk-in sales it supplies catering trays to two nearby offices, which account for roughly 15% of sales. The owner runs the business day to day and is selling to retire.
operations: The café is open seven days a week. Six part-time staff work alongside the owner, who spends about 45 hours a week on the floor and keeps the books. The owner's spouse is on payroll part-time for social media; that cost is treated as an addback and assumed to end at sale. The lease has four years remaining with one five-year renewal option.
growth_opportunities: Win more catering clients beyond the current two offices
Introduce seasonal menu items to raise the average ticket
buyer_questions: What is the monthly rent, and what escalations apply over the remaining term and the renewal?
Can every addback be supported with receipts, payroll records or statements?
Who will handle social media and bookkeeping after the owner and spouse leave, and at what cost?
Are the two catering clients under contract, and can those agreements be transferred?
How seasonal are sales around the university calendar?
What equipment beyond the espresso machine is included, and what condition is it in?
What is the status of the equipment loan, and will it be paid off at closing?
What justifies an asking price above 3x weighted SDE?
missing_info: Lease agreement with rent, escalations and renewal terms
T2 returns or Notices of Assessment for FY2023 to FY2025
Payroll records, including the spouse's wages
Equipment list with ages and condition
Monthly sales for the last 24 months
